notablePrerequisites:
"Beast" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
Wizard Class is level three.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Kindred Discovery, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
